# coolify_backup_executions (Data Source)

The runs of a database backup schedule (`coolify_database_backup`) — useful to alert on failed backups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_backup_executions" "pg_nightly" {
  database_uuid = coolify_database.pg.uuid
  backup_uuid   = coolify_database_backup.nightly.uuid
}

output "last_backup_status" {
  value = try(data.coolify_backup_executions.pg_nightly.executions[0].status, "none")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backup_uuid` (String) UUID of the backup schedule.
- `database_uuid` (String) UUID of the database.

### Read-Only

- `executions` (Attributes List) Backup runs, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--executions))

<a id="nestedatt--executions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `executions`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Run timestamp.
- `filename` (String) Stored filename.
- `message` (String) Error message when failed.
- `size` (Number) Backup size in bytes.
- `status` (String) success / failed / running.
- `uuid` (String) Run UUID.
